modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
follow safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
carry out routine check of the machine for identifying potential hazards
use appropriate protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work
follow safety hazards and preventive techniques during fire drill
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workstation and equipment are regularly clean and sanitized
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques

modules.module_title: Perform work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure that work is accomplished as per the requirements within the specified timeline

check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
report malfunctioning (fumes/ sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use

pcs.pc_description: set the parameters of induction heaters/ furnace at a desired temperature range for preheating, heating as well as post heating zones
load the billets in the furnace by using manual techniques or hoists, cranes, magnetic lifters etc.
ensure that each thermal/ heating zone reaches the desired temperature levels when the billets are passing through the furnace
observe the uniform heating of metal as per the desired specifications
lift the hot metal from the furnace and load it into a compressing machine by using hoists, cranes, magnetic lifters ensure that
start the compression machine and perform the compression process to reduce the diameter and increase the length of the hot billet as per the process requirements of forging stage
inspect the output from compressing machine for required quality standards and measure the workpiece for geometry, material & dimensional parameters
remove the bad quality billets from the main production line and allow the accepted billets to cool down for forging process
select the right program in the forging machine and make changes/modifications in the program as per the work instructions and production requirements
feed the heated metal bars into forging presses with the help of magnetic robots
adjust temperature of the die to ensure uniform heating of the workpiece
adjust various parameters of main press machine including blocker, finisher and trimmer (like pressure, cycle time, etc.) as per the output requirement
monitor the process parameters by reading the various gauges and correct them if not within standards
monitor the forging operations and record the operational data as per the frequency in the control plan
ensure that the dies are being sprayed with coolants after every operation
remove the forged workpiece from machine and allow it to cool for sometime
perform finishing operations such as twisting, straightening etc. on workpiece to get the desired specifications
measure the first workpiece for geometry, material & dimensional parameters and compare it with the specifications prescribed in the work order and engineering drawing
adjust the parameters of the corresponding presses for the finishing operations i.e. twisting, straightening etc. if required to get the desired specifications
run the machine for mass production of workpieces, when first-piece meets the specified requirements
report any emergencies/deviations from the Work Instructions/ Control Panel/SOP to the supervisor immediately

pcs.pc_description: clean the shot blasting machine by using air pressure blast to remove any dust particles and unwanted material
check the shot blasting machine and its components for defects before use
load the work pieces and shots on shot blasting machine and place the same securely on the designated slot/space as indicated in the WI
start the machine and remove the surface imperfections from both sides of the workpiece as per the WI
ensure that machine is in the moving position till the cycle time for both sides cycle is achieved as per the WI/ SOP
remove the workpieces carefully from the machine and load them into the designated trolley

modules.module_title: Perform quality check and inspection of workpieces

pcs.pc_description: check the work pieces as per the work instructions for product quality
conduct destructive and non-destructive tests on the work pieces
perform eddy current testing as per the WI to identify the flaws in workpiece
perform magnetic particle inspection process as per the WI to identify the surface discontinuities in workpiece

adjust the parameters of the apparatus (MPI Machine/other machinery) like current to be passed, power cycles, time duration, intensity of magnetic flux etc. as per the requirement of magnetic particle inspection process
ensure that the parts are first magnetized and then demagnetized as per the magnetic cycles set for the machine in magnetic particle inspection process
compare the texture, color, surface properties, hardness and strength with the given product specifications
note down the observations of the basic inspection process and identify pieces which are as per the specified standards
rectify minor defects like shape deformation, sharp edges, rough surfaces, extra material from grooves, holes, parting line area etc. from the workpieces
segregate the completed pieces in to Ok pieces, defective pieces which can be repaired/reworked and pieces which are beyond repair and maintain records of each category
tag and store the right quality pieces by following organisational policies and procedures
check the machine operations for any malfunctions/ defects in the component and inform the supervisor/maintenance team for correction
clean the tools, forging apparatus and shot blasting machine after completion of all activities
dispose scrap or waste material into the disposal area in accordance with the company's policies and environmental regulations
provide first and last work piece from each batch to the lab for quality check on its composition, soundness, metallography/grain structure, etc.
obtain batch clearance from the lab
